description: React component for a modal dialog that handles exporting data to CloudZero or CSV, including configuration management and export actions.

methods.name: loadExistingSettings
methods.description: Fetches existing CloudZero settings from backend and updates form and state.

methods.name: handleSaveCloudZeroSettings
methods.description: Saves CloudZero configuration settings to backend.

methods.name: handleExportCloudZero
methods.description: Triggers export data to CloudZero via backend API.

methods.name: handleExport
methods.description: Main export handler that decides between CloudZero and CSV export.

methods.name: handleModalClose
methods.description: Resets form and state, then closes modal.
